      "evidence": "Labeled Kernel; adds `btck_chainstate_manager_set_clock_time` and options to `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h`, `bitcoinkernel.cpp`, and `bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h`.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds per-instance clock control to the kernel API, addressing a key limitation where mock time leaked across concurrent instances or threads. Removing process-global state from the library boundary is core to libbitcoinkernel usability."
